sources: https://threeriversparks.link/Baker_ParkReserve_Campground (Baker Park Reserve Campground summer map PDF, updated 4/29/2026)

values.note: Three Rivers Park District: non-electric $25, 30-amp $33, 50/30-amp $37 a night, tax included. $8.25 non-refundable reservation fee and $8.25 per change (changes up to three days before arrival). Camper cabins $93.

fees.source: https://www.threeriversparks.org/location/baker-campground ('$25 (tax included) per non-electric', '$33 (tax included) per site with 30 amp electrical service', '$37 (tax included) per site with 50/30 amp electrical service', 'An $8.25 (tax included) non-refundable reservation fee applies', 'Each site can accommodate two tents or one tent and one RV, and a maximum of eight people'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Reserve online or by calling 763-559-6700. When the campground office is closed, a same-day site can be booked from the QR code at the office. Check-in 4 p.m., check-out 3 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.threeriversparks.org/location/baker-campground ('Reserve a campsite or cabin online or by calling 763-559-6700', 'Reservations are available from 120 days prior to the check-in date', 'For same-day reservations when the campground office is closed, use the QR code located at the campground office', 'Check-In Time: 4 PM / Check-Out Time: 3 PM'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Electric loops: G (30 amp); B, D, F, H and J (50/30 amp). Loops A, C and E are non-electric.

hookups.source: https://threeriversparks.link/Baker_ParkReserve_Campground (map: '* Electric Loops G (30 amp), B, D, F, H and J (50/30 amp)', '* Non-electric Loops A, C, and E') + campground page (50/30-amp rate), read 2026-11-11

sites.source: https://www.threeriversparks.org/location/baker-campground ('Baker has 203 campsites, including 103 with electricity'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://www.threeriversparks.org/location/baker-campground ('wheelchair accessible showers and flush toilets nearby. There is an RV dump station available for registered campsite visitors'), read 2026-11-11

note: Three Rivers Park District campground in Baker Park Reserve, which has swimming beaches, boat access, bike and hiking trails; Lake Independence is beyond the campground, not beside the loops. Five camper cabins. Generators are not allowed in Loop C. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the park district page: 203 sites (103 electric), 30 and 50/30 amp, showers, flush toilets, dump, 120-day online booking. Base corrected from $33 to $25: the non-electric sites take 'one tent and one RV'. Added tax-included, the $8.25 fee, the 8-person cap and the loop-by-loop electric map. Closed for the 2026 season now; opening/closing dates not published.
flags: Fees changed: nightly_low 33 -> 25. The page prices non-electric sites at $25 and says 'Each site can accommodate two tents or one tent and one RV', so a non-electric site is the cheapest a 23-ft motorhome can book. No per-site length is published.

Status: the page reads 'Closed for the season' / 'Closed for the 2026 season' (ordinary end of season, not a status). No 2027 open/close dates are posted; the 2027 host sessions run 'Late April–May' to 'September–October'. Season left unset.

Construction: the page carries 'Highway 12 Construction: Baker Park Reserve Access' (intermittent closures between County Road 101 and I-494 starting in April) and 'Baker Boo 2026 — Limited availability due to construction'. Not a campground closure.
Waterfront: confirmed not waterfront. On the park district's 2026 map Lake Independence sits at the far NW corner, past the play area, and no loop reaches it.
Pin 45.0172,-93.6372 sits in Loop H inside the campground; fine. Phone 763-694-7662 matches the page; reservations are 763-559-6700.
Note cleaned: dropped the site counts, amperage, dump, toilets/showers and 'Reservable online' (fields hold them).
